item.title: TeamPCP Linked To Redis Attacks Dating Back To 2020 And Later Supply Chain Campaign
item.summary: A new analysis has uncovered that the threat actor tracked as TeamPCP has been active on the cybercrime scene as far back as 2020, indicating the group has been compromising internet-facing infrastructure for years before training their sights on the software supply chain.
